description: He wears an opaque deep navy knee-length tunic with pale gold geometric woven trim along a V-shaped neckline, cuffs and hem. A fine cream underlayer shows at the neck and wrists. A round decorated metal brooch accents one side of the upper tunic. A brown leather belt with small geometric gold fittings, a circular buckle and a hanging decorated tail sits at the waist. Brown trousers are tucked into brown cloth leg wraps secured by narrow crossing straps, above dark brown leather ankle boots. The outfit has substantial wool-like texture, but exact fiber cannot be confirmed.
